verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents AuthKit as a spec-compatible OAuth authorization server built to manage access to your own MCP server, and lists built-in support for MCP and OAuth applications, so the core of the story is delivered. Token verification is supported indirectly through SDK JWKS helpers. Missing for 10: MCP-specific detail on token scoping and audience/verification (e.g. protected-resource metadata, dynamic client registration), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP auth flow.
